archive.title: Identity archive
archive.footnote: "Straight line" is the arc between airports: real tracks run longer, and this measures where a parcel went, not what an aircraft flew. Capacity is what carriers declared — nothing was weighed. The signatures were made while the key was live, and they still verify.
archive.anchoredAsOf: Independently checkable as of {{date}}: chain heads for {{part}} of {{total}} deals are published on third-party relays. Anything written after that date rests on our own integrity check alone.
archive.bannerUndecided: The public page stays open after {{date}} unless you say otherwise.
archive.modalTitle: The key is gone. What now
archive.modalWhat: You can no longer sign: neither you nor we hold the key. Signing in still works — that is how you got here.
archive.modalRemains: Everything signed earlier stands and still verifies. Your vouches keep working: the signature was made while the key was alive. Nothing is deleted — the chain and the deal history are half your counterparties'.
archive.modalWindow: One thing is left to decide: whether your public page stays. Do nothing and on {{date}} it stays open, and the answer is fixed.
archive.modalWindowClosed: The window has passed — the page stayed open.
archive.modalNoAccess: If you lose access to the account as well, nobody is left to answer and the same thing happens: the page stays.
archive.hideConsequences: Only the display closes: the page, the name and any part in shared figures. Records, signatures and deal events stay — half of them are not yours. In the trust graph the identity becomes an unnamed node and its vouches keep working. This cannot be undone.
archive.hideUnderstood: I understand the page closes for good and cannot be brought back.
archive.pageHint: This identity's page now reads as a historical record. Keeping or closing it is decided in the notice above.

identity.vaultHint: Take a copy of your key in a file only you can open. Ours stays where it is — nothing about your account changes.
identity.vaultPassPlaceholder: Passphrase for the file, at least 8 characters
identity.vaultPassNotice: This is not your account password, and we never see it. Forget it while we still hold a copy of your key and you simply download again with a new one.
identity.vaultConfirmBody: Confirm it is you. The key is sealed in your browser and the file is saved to this device.
identity.vaultDone: Saved. Keep the file somewhere other than the device you sign in from.
identity.vaultOnlyYours: We no longer hold a copy of this key — it exists only in your Identity Vault.
identity.sealCta: Seal a key you already have
identity.sealKeyPlaceholder: nsec1… or the 64-character hex from your backup
identity.sealLocalNotice: This never leaves the page: the key is sealed here and the file is saved to this device. Use it to replace a plain-text backup with an encrypted one.
identity.sealFailed: That does not look like a private key — check the format.
identity.vaultFailed: Could not prepare the file. Try again.
identity.readerHint: Opens a .dvlt file with your passphrase. It is a separate page on purpose: save it and it keeps working when this site does not.
identity.hintService: Your vault is encrypted with a key Vimana generated and keeps. It is a working key, not an identity — we would not ask you to trust a key we have held all along.
identity.hintOwn: This key is yours alone. We hold only its public half and cannot sign or decrypt anything for you.
identity.hintLost: This key is gone. The account can still be signed into, but it can no longer sign anything or open its own encrypted history.
identity.importCta: Bring a key I already have
identity.importHint: An Identity Vault file, or the key itself. It is unsealed here in your browser — the passphrase is never sent anywhere.
identity.importPassPlaceholder: Passphrase — for a file or an ncryptsec key
identity.importFailed: Could not read that key. Check the passphrase, the file, or the format.
identity.changedOn: The key of this identity was changed on {{date}}.
identity.swapCheckbox: I understand that everything signed so far stays signed by a key this account will no longer have
identity.warnBody: A different key becomes this account's identity: your deal vaults are re-encrypted to it and the current key is destroyed. Your deals, history and activity level stay. To own your existing key, download the Identity Vault above and then remove our copy — that keeps the identity you already have.
identity.dropCta: Remove our copy of the key
identity.dropTitle: After this we cannot act for you.
identity.dropBody: Your key, your npub and your deals stay exactly as they are. What ends is our ability: we will no longer be able to sign or open your vaults, because there will be nothing here to do it with. From then on it works from your Identity Vault file or a Nostr extension.
identity.dropCheckbox: I understand that Vimana will not be able to open my vaults afterwards
identity.dropConfirmBody: Confirm it is you. We delete our copy of the key; the identity itself does not change.
identity.generateCta: Create a key in this browser
identity.saveKeyBody: This key was created on your device and has not been sent anywhere. Save it now — it is shown once.
identity.savedConfirm: I have saved this key and understand Vimana cannot restore it.
identity.declareLostWarn: This retires the account: it can still be signed into, but not act. It cannot be undone.
identity.errorProof: The signature did not check out. Try again.
identity.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.

keypair.title: Nostr identity
keypair.custodialHint: We keep your encrypted private key so we can sign your chat events. You can export and switch to self-custody at any time.
keypair.selfCustodyHint: You hold your own private key. Vault messages are signed by your NIP-07 extension (Alby, nos2x, etc.).
keypair.nip07Detected: NIP-07 browser extension detected — you can claim self-custody and sign vault messages locally.
keypair.exportHint: Confirm your password to receive your Nostr nsec. Keep it secret.
keypair.exportWarn: Save this key somewhere safe. If lost, you can't sign or decrypt your history without it.
keypair.claimWarn: We will delete our encrypted copy of your private key. If you lose access to your NIP-07 extension you will not be able to sign new messages.
keypair.claimHint: After claim, every vault message is signed locally by your browser extension. Make sure you have exported and safely stored your nsec first.
keypair.importHint: Replace the current keypair. If you paste nsec — we never store it, and you'll be in self-custody. npub only = tracking mode (read).
